definitions.explanation: A technical drawing or diagram that shows the internal structure, framework, or organization of something. Used in engineering, architecture, science, and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{構造図|こうぞうず}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check the structural diagram of the building.

examples.japanese: {構造図|こうぞうず}を{見|み}れば{内部|ないぶ}の{仕組|しく}みがわかる。
examples.english: You can understand the internal mechanism by looking at the structural diagram.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}には{細胞|さいぼう}の{構造図|こうぞうず}が{載|の}っていて、それぞれの{部分|ぶぶん}の{役割|やくわり}が{説明|せつめい}されている。
examples.english: The textbook has a structural diagram of a cell, with the role of each part explained.

notes:
A compound of {構造|こうぞう} (structure) and {図|ず} (diagram, drawing). Applied broadly: in architecture and engineering it means a structural drawing of a building's framework; in science it means a diagram showing internal components; in business it can mean an organizational chart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構造図|こうぞうず}を{描|えが}く: to draw a structural diagram
- {構造図|こうぞうず}を{見|み}る: to look at a structural diagram
- {組織|そしき}{構造図|こうぞうず}: organizational structure chart
- {建築|けんちく}{構造図|こうぞうず}: architectural structural drawing

RELATED WORDS:
- {設計図|せっけいず}: blueprint, design drawing — focuses on the design intent rather than structural analysis
- {断面図|だんめんず}: cross-section diagram — shows a cut-through view
- {配置図|はいちず}: layout diagram — shows the arrangement of elements
